kept_on_mac: What Chewbacca reads stays in files in your own account on this Mac, mostly in the ~/.chewbacca folder. Words from texts, email and chats are kept in its summary file, ~/.chewbacca/os-graph.sqlite, for at most 7 days, then wiped, not just hidden.
assistant: Chewbacca does not have a model of its own. When you ask your assistant something, the parts it reads to answer go to that assistant's company, the same as anything you type to it: Anthropic for the Claude app, OpenAI for ChatGPT or Codex. Nothing goes there until you ask.
never: Chewbacca has no account and no server of its own. Your data stays on this Mac unless you choose to back up your notes to your own GitHub.
A text or email goes out only when you ask for it in a conversation with your assistant.
Setup sends nothing about you anywhere. It copies files into your own account.

imessage.name: Texts
imessage.reads: Messages on this Mac, read straight from its own file
imessage.leaves: Only the texts your assistant reads to answer you, and only when you ask.

mail.name: Email
mail.reads: Gmail, through Google's own sign-in, as you
mail.leaves: Nothing new: the mail already lives at Google. What your assistant reads to answer you goes to its company.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.reads: the Calendar app on this Mac
calendar.leaves: Only the events your assistant reads to answer you.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.reads: the Reminders app on this Mac
reminders.leaves: Only the reminders your assistant reads to answer you.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
whatsapp.reads: a linked-device copy of your WhatsApp kept on this Mac
whatsapp.leaves: Only the messages your assistant reads to answer you.

meetings.name: Meetings
meetings.reads: meeting notes recorded and transcribed on this Mac
meetings.leaves: Only the notes your assistant reads to answer you.

chats.name: Other chats
chats.reads: Signal, Telegram, Discord and similar, from a copy kept on this Mac
chats.leaves: Only the messages your assistant reads to answer you.

slack.name: Slack

slack.leaves: Only the messages your assistant reads to answer you.

people.leaves: Only what your assistant reads to answer you.
